what: Precision attainable for a paired format contrast, estimated from development data (banking, 16 user tasks, 72 pairs, fixed baseline attack, one run). Only the interval widths were used for planning; the point estimate is descriptive development data and was not used.
projection_assumption: Half-width scales with the inverse square root of the number of user tasks; between-task variance on Slack, workspace and travel is assumed similar to banking. Unverified.
repeat_runs: In the 100 development-control cells run three times, 0 had disagreeing runs (temperature 0). Attack episodes were run once, so their repeatability is unmeasured.
